verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a Kimi help-center section title for installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills. That implies the assistant can add plugins, and publishing suggests a shared catalog, but nothing documents a browsable directory of third-party apps or connectors or how adding them works. Missing for 10: documented browsable connector/app directory, third-party connector catalog contents, step-by-step add/enable flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: 插件和技能 安装、创建和发布 Kimi 插件与技能
